rules: One selected Finisher path per competitive deck
Maximum two method types in competitive move suites
No foreign wrestler Trademarks or Finishers
Second Trademark only when it shares a chosen method or explicitly supports the selected path
Actions, Support, Entrance and Gameplan pages scored for strategy fit
Competitive and catalogue-showcase libraries are separated
Full authentic booster and fixed-product pool considered
Maximum five copies of one card
